worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.summary: Scatter poison caltrops over a patch of ground: a grounded enemy whose feet are on the same layer that steps in is poisoned and stays poisoned while it remains, but a target already carrying an equal or stronger poison is not re-applied and its badly-poison progress is never reset. Laying them again on the same same-layer patch by the same caster stacks a second layer, which upgrades the poison to badly poisoned; bodies on a floor above do not step on the patch below. An enemy Poison-type body walking in absorbs the whole patch; Steel types and immune foes pass through.
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.use.0: Close off a narrow path or a doorway in advance
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.use.2: Stack a second layer for badly poisoned
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.descriptio: A grounded enemy whose feet are on the same layer that steps in is poisoned for %1$s (badly poisoned at the second layer); the patch is %2$s blocks in radius. An enemy Poison-type body absorbs the whole patch unharmed, while Steel types and immune foes pass straight through, and a target already carrying an equal or stronger poison is not re-applied.

A patch of toxic spikes stays in the world for %1$s; a foe that stays inside keeps its poison, but a target already carrying an equal or stronger poison keeps only its own legal remaining time and its badly-poison progress is never reset; a foe that leaves walks it off over the remaining time.
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.option.on: Virulent on: poison lasts about x1.4, but the patch narrows to about 0.8x, lives less long, +2 ticks wind-up and a longer cooldown - for poisoning one target for a long time.
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.option.off: Virulent off (mild): the patch lays about 1.15x wider, lives longer and is faster to lay, at about x0.8 poison duration - for covering a patch and waiting.
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.timing: Lay the spikes at a point within %1$s: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.growth.0: At level %1$s, the poison lasts %2$s and the patch radius rises to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.preference: On: poison lasts about x1.4, but the patch narrows to about 0.8x, lives less long, +2 ticks wind-up and a longer cooldown. Off: the mild form lays about 1.15x wider, lives longer and is faster to lay, at about x0.8 poison duration.
The partner only considers laying on a threat this close; smaller keeps it for nearby ground, larger seeds the path ahead.
Lead a moving target by this many ticks; 0 lays on its current spot, larger suits stopping a charging foe.
world_combat.move.toxicspikes.text.toxic: Stepped on toxic spikes: badly poisoned
worldcombat.skill.toxicspikes.descriptio: While poisoned a target keeps losing health, and at the second layer the poison bites harder; only the same caster laying again inside an existing patch stacks a layer, up to a maximum of two.
